pages.title: Venue planning, built for agents and humans
pages.description: A versioned spatial-planning system where agents inspect, propose, validate, and compare—while humans retain the commit decision.

pages.title: venue.list_projects
pages.description: List durable VenueMind Projects available to the current authenticated or local host scope without returning full snapshots.

pages.title: venue.open_project
pages.description: Select one durable Project as the active Project for this agent session. This never changes accepted Plan truth.

pages.title: venue.inspect_templates
pages.description: Read versioned Venue, Room, and Inventory Item Templates, including starter room types and current inventory availability metadata.

pages.title: venue.get_project_brief
pages.description: Read the structured Event Brief, stable Requirement IDs, priorities, ownership, ambiguity flags, and accepted-Plan versus active-Proposal coverage.

pages.title: venue.list_constraints
pages.description: List versioned Constraints with current evaluation status, thresholds, policy sources, and remediation metadata.

pages.title: venue.inspect_layout
pages.description: Read the active venue plan, stable object IDs, locked objects, constraints, metrics, proposal state, and branch summaries.

pages.title: venue.get_object
pages.description: Read one stable object with scoped accepted or Proposal geometry, operational metadata, and effective Locks.

pages.title: venue.search_objects
pages.description: Search stable venue objects with bounded text, kind, layer, Lock, and accepted-versus-Proposal filters.

pages.title: venue.preview_revision
pages.description: Create a non-destructive venue revision preview. The result remains pending until a human approves it in VenueMind.

pages.title: venue.preview_template_update
pages.description: Create a non-destructive Proposal containing safe Room Template differences while preserving Project Overrides. Human Approval is always required.

pages.title: venue.apply_edit
pages.description: Create one non-destructive, undoable spatial editing Change for placement, transform, duplication, alignment, distribution, grouping, zoning, paste, or deletion.

pages.title: venue.measure_objects
pages.description: Measure deterministic center points and pairwise distances for selected Project objects.

pages.title: venue.validate_layout
pages.description: Validate the visible proposal or committed plan against locks, accessibility, capacity, sightlines, and circulation constraints.

pages.title: venue.get_validation_evidence
pages.description: Read deterministic evidence for the current Validation, optionally restricted to stable Constraint IDs.

pages.title: venue.list_proposal_branches
pages.description: Compare proposal branches by base version, change count, validation status, unresolved issues, and projected metrics.

pages.title: venue.compare_proposal_branches
pages.description: Compare two Proposal Branches by spatial object differences, Change membership, projected metrics, and deterministic Constraint improvements or regressions.

pages.title: venue.create_proposal_branch
pages.description: Create and activate a non-destructive proposal branch using a balanced, access-first, circulation-first, or sightlines-first strategy.

pages.title: venue.switch_proposal_branch
pages.description: Activate an existing proposal branch in the visible VenueMind workspace without approving it.

pages.title: venue.update_proposal_branch
pages.description: Update a Proposal Branch name or review notes without changing its Proposal geometry.

pages.title: venue.duplicate_proposal_branch
pages.description: Duplicate the current or a prior Proposal revision into a new active Branch with preserved stable Change IDs.

pages.title: venue.archive_proposal_branch
pages.description: Archive a Proposal Branch without deleting its revisions or audit history.

pages.title: venue.restore_proposal_branch
pages.description: Restore an archived Proposal Branch to the active comparison set.

pages.title: venue.detect_proposal_conflicts
pages.description: Detect stale-base, deleted-dependency, locked-object, same-object, and Constraint-regression conflicts for a Proposal Branch.

pages.title: venue.rebase_proposal
pages.description: Rebase a stale Proposal Branch onto the latest accepted Plan Version while preserving unchanged stable Change IDs.

pages.title: venue.request_adjustment
pages.description: Create a new non-destructive Proposal revision recording an agent-requested adjustment. Human Approval is still required.

pages.title: venue.list_comments
pages.description: Read comments by status, author, subject kind, or decision relevance without changing planning state.

pages.title: venue.add_comment
pages.description: Add a non-planning Comment anchored to an immutable VenueMind subject or spatial coordinate.

pages.title: venue.edit_comment
pages.description: Edit Comment text, mentions, or decision relevance while retaining immutable edit history.

pages.title: venue.set_comment_status
pages.description: Resolve or reopen a Comment without changing its immutable anchor or planning state.

pages.title: venue.get_change_log
pages.description: Read the ordered human and agent Activity Ledger for the active Plan.

pages.title: venue.replay_history
pages.description: Verify the Activity Ledger hash chain and replay accepted Plan transitions against the current Plan fingerprint.

pages.title: venue.list_scenarios
pages.description: Read stored immutable Scenario definitions without running a simulation.

pages.title: venue.list_scenario_runs
pages.description: Read queued, running, completed, cancelled, and failed Simulation Runs, including progress and partial results.

pages.title: venue.get_scenario_result
pages.description: Read one stable Scenario Run and its completed or partial result, with density frames omitted unless explicitly requested.

pages.title: venue.run_scenario
pages.description: Run one seeded operations, ingress-egress, or spatial queue Scenario against an exact Proposal Branch geometry. Results never replace deterministic Validation.

pages.title: venue.compare_simulations
pages.description: Compare two completed Runs with matching Scenario fingerprints and engine versions across Proposal Branches, including clearance, bottleneck, and accessible-route deltas for flow models.

pages.title: venue.export_simulation
pages.description: Export one completed Simulation Run with its normalized Scenario parameters, engine version, input fingerprint, and confidence metadata.

pages.title: venue.inspect_live_occupancy
pages.description: Read the current aggregate-only Live Occupancy projection, source freshness, active Alerts, simulation deltas, and incident Ledger without person-level records.

pages.title: venue.ingest_occupancy_signal
pages.description: Ingest one bounded aggregate Occupancy Signal from a registration total, sensor, or manual counter with stable source and scope IDs.

pages.title: venue.refresh_live_occupancy
pages.description: Refresh Live Occupancy freshness and derived Alerts at the server-accepted instant without changing any aggregate count.

pages.title: venue.export_live_occupancy
pages.description: Export the verified aggregate-only Live Occupancy audit artifact with baseline, observations, Alerts, receipts, and hash-chained incident Ledger.

pages.title: venue.inspect_incidents
pages.description: Inspect the Runbook-bound Incident Register or one stable Operational Incident with structured severity, category, owner, location, acknowledgement, escalation, evidence, and ordered ledger state.

pages.title: venue.report_incident
pages.description: Report one structured Operational Incident against an object or coordinate in the frozen accepted Plan without claiming acknowledgement, escalation, ownership, resolution, or emergency authority.

pages.title: venue.export_incident_record
pages.description: Export one verified post-event Operational Incident record with frozen Plan and Emergency Plan provenance, transitions, structured handoffs, receipts, and hash-chained ledger evidence.

pages.title: venue.inspect_live_plan_deviations
pages.description: Inspect the Runbook-bound Live Plan Deviation Register, deterministic active overlay, and filtered temporary or revision-candidate deviation records without changing accepted Plan truth.

pages.title: venue.record_live_plan_deviation
pages.description: Record one validated event-day Change against the frozen accepted Plan with stable object IDs, available live Constraints, reason, author evidence, and exact retry identity.

pages.title: venue.end_live_plan_deviation
pages.description: End one active temporary or revision-candidate deviation with optimistic Deviation revision control and an immutable reasoned transition.

pages.title: venue.create_post_event_deviation_proposal
pages.description: Create a normal review-state Proposal from ended revision-candidate deviations. The accepted Plan remains unchanged and Approval remains human-only in VenueMind Studio.

pages.title: venue.export_live_plan_deviations
pages.description: Export a verified record that keeps the approved Plan, live deviation overlay, and post-event recommended revisions explicitly separate.

pages.title: venue.inspect_post_event_review
pages.description: Inspect a Runbook-bound Post-event Review, outcome comparisons, Lessons, proposals, and ledger integrity.

pages.title: venue.record_post_event_observation
pages.description: Record one evidence-bound outcome against a frozen Prediction.

pages.title: venue.record_post_event_lesson
pages.description: Record one Lesson linked to a Comparison and frozen Requirement or Constraint IDs.

pages.title: venue.create_template_improvement_proposal
pages.description: Create an evidence-traced Template Improvement Proposal pending human review.

pages.title: venue.export_post_event_report
pages.description: Export an integrity-verified Post-event Report with provenance and ledger evidence.

pages.title: venue.export_audit_package
pages.description: Export the portable audit package with Plan, Proposal, Validation, receipts, Comments, replay, and hash-chained Activity Ledger evidence.

pages.title: venue.export_plan
pages.description: Export the validated Plan as JSON, compact text, layered SVG, print-ready plan or emergency PDF, object, inventory, staffing, production, catering, or replenishment CSV, staffing or production SVG, or a portable audit package.
